timer_toggle_auto_start_work_desc: Automatically begin the next work session after a break ends.
timer_toggle_auto_start_break_desc: Automatically begin a break when a work session ends.
timer_toggle_short_breaks_desc: Skip the short break between work rounds.
timer_toggle_long_breaks_desc: Skip the long break at the end of each cycle.
timer_toggle_countdown_desc: Arc starts full and subtracts as time passes.
notif_toggle_desktop_desc: Show a system notification when each round ends.
notif_toggle_tick_work_desc: Play a ticking sound during work sessions.
notif_toggle_tick_break_desc: Play a ticking sound during break sessions.
system_toggle_aot_desc: Keep the timer window above all other windows.
system_toggle_break_aot_desc: Disable always-on-top while a break is running.
system_toggle_show_tray_desc: Display a persistent icon in the system tray.
system_tray_gnome_hint: On GNOME, tray icons require the AppIndicator extension. Install it with your package manager (e.g. gnome-shell-extension-appindicator) or from extensions.gnome.org, then log out and back in.
system_toggle_min_tray_desc: Hide the window to the tray when minimized.
system_toggle_close_tray_desc: Hide to the tray instead of quitting when the window is closed.
system_toggle_websocket_desc: Expose a local WebSocket endpoint for external integrations (port {port}).
system_toggle_check_updates_desc: Automatically check for new versions when Settings is opened.
shortcuts_accessibility_notice: Global shortcuts require Accessibility access on macOS. Enable Pomotroid in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Accessibility.
shortcuts_note: Global shortcuts work even when the window is not focused. Click a field and press your desired key combination to record it.
shortcuts_toggle_enabled_desc: Register system-wide keyboard shortcuts for controlling the timer.
shortcuts_local_note: Active while the app window is focused. Click a field and press a key to rebind.
advanced_toggle_verbose_logging_desc: Enable detailed debug logging to help diagnose issues.
about_reset_confirm: This will reset all settings to defaults.
stats_empty_history: Complete your first session to see your history
notification_work_body: Time to get back to work. You've got this!
notification_work_start_body: Time to focus. You've got this!
notification_short_break_body: Take a short break. Stretch, breathe, relax.
notification_long_break_body: You've earned a long break. Step away and recharge.
tooltip_restart_round: Restart the current round from the beginning.
tooltip_reset: Reset the timer to the first work round. Current session progress will be cleared.
tooltip_round_counter: Current work round out of the total rounds before a long break.
tooltip_round_counter_session: Continuous session round count. Resets only when the timer is reset.
tooltip_verbose_logging: Enables detailed debug logging. Use when reporting issues. Log files are accessible via Open Log Folder in Settings → About.
tooltip_dial_countdown: When enabled, the progress arc counts down to zero instead of filling up.
tooltip_auto_start_work: Automatically start the next work round when a break ends.
tooltip_auto_start_break: Automatically start the break when a work round completes.
tooltip_websocket: Enables a local WebSocket server for external integrations such as stream overlays. Disabled by default.
timer_toggle_incremental_desc: Each work round is longer than the last, up to a maximum.
timer_increment_ladder_hint: Durations climb with each completed work round, then reset after a long break or on a new day.
timer_increment_capped: Capped — later rounds hold at the maximum focus duration.
timer_toggle_increment_reset_long_break_: The first focus round after a long break starts at your base focus time.
timer_toggle_increment_reset_daily_desc: The first focus round of a new day starts at your base focus time.
timer_increment_reset_now_desc: Start the next round at the base focus duration. Round counters are untouched.
timer_increment_reset_done: Ladder reset — the next round starts at the base duration.
timer_increment_hint_daily: Durations climb with each completed work round, then reset at the start of a new day.
timer_increment_hint_long_break: Durations climb with each completed work round, then reset after a long break.
timer_increment_hint_never: Durations keep climbing with every completed work round until you reset the ladder.
tooltip_incremental_focus: Incremental focus is on: each completed work round lengthens the next one.
better_no_average: Complete a few rounds to unlock comparisons
better_trend_hint: Rounds per day over the last 28 days
better_weeks_hint: Rounds per week over the last 12 weeks
better_streak_at_risk: Log a round today to keep it alive
better_empty_body: Finish your first focus round and this page fills up with trends, streaks and your personal rhythm.
better_heatmap_hint: Hover a square to see that day
better_grid_hint: Hover a cell for that hour's total
better_consistency_steady_hint: Lower spread means a steadier routine
better_span_concentration_hint: Share of all focus in your busiest day of the week
